regions.region: page 1 title, authors, metadata, abstract, and graphical abstract
regions.finding: Verified the article title and current photocatalytic 1,4-carbocarboxylation class. The graphical abstract's 39 examples/up-to-82% statement is aggregate evidence for the current general scheme, not 39 additional experiments beyond Scheme 2.

regions.region: page 1 two-column introduction and conventional-route discussion
regions.finding: Classified allene-intermediate routes, oxidation/hydrolysis, and metal-mediated carboxylation/carbonylation as cited prior work represented by Scheme 1 on page 2. External cited experiments were not promoted to current-paper runs.

unresolved: Graphical-abstract structures are generic and do not define experiment-specific charges or structures.
No workspace SI association is established.

regions.finding: Scheme 1a is contextual natural-product structure display with no reaction. Scheme 1b and the two Scheme 1c routes are cited/generic prior approaches; Scheme 1d is the current general reaction class. None was assigned a Table 1 row yield.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 1 entries 1-12 and footnotes a-b
regions.finding: Recorded every optimization/control condition independently. Entry 3's slash-separated PC/tBuSH/HCO2K omissions were split into three distinct controls, and the prose-explicit base omission was retained as a fourth control. Shared amounts, 1 atm CO2, 40 W blue LEDs, room temperature/24 h, 2 N HCl, NMR basis, isolated parenthetical yield, N.D. and all replacements were applied row-wise.

Linked prose conclusions to Table 1 controls. Entries 11-12 retain the qualitative substantial-starting-material-recovery statement without assigning an unprinted percentage or an unambiguous recovered entity.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right beginning of Scheme 2 scope discussion
regions.finding: Linked enyne-scope products 3-17 to their page-3 rows. Product 3 is merged with Table 1 entry 1 because both report the same 82% standard result. Product 13 receives CCDC 2473796 characterization provenance.

unresolved: Source condition discrepancy for the standard experiment: Table 1 gives tBuSH 0.1 mmol, while Scheme 2 gives 30 mol%.
Entry 3 compresses three omission controls into one displayed row; the base omission is prose-only.
Table 1 omits purification, isolated masses, and numerical N.D. limits.

regions.region: page 3 left Scheme 2 reaction header and products 3-17
regions.finding: Recorded the standard Scope conditions and every distinct enyne row 3-17 with isolated yield. Product 3 is merged with Table 1 entry 1; the conflicting tBuSH 30 mol% versus Table 1 0.1 mmol statements remain separate. Product 13 retains CCDC 2473796.
Recorded all seventeen aryl/heteroaryl-iodide scope rows independently with the depicted partner labels and isolated yields 47-82%; no compact structure was forced into an uncertain SMILES.

Recorded iodocyclohexane, N-Boc-4-iodopiperidine, iodoadamantane, and four late-stage rows independently. The displayed 1:1 dr values for 38 and 40 are product-targeted; their analytical basis remains missing.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right Scheme 3 gram-scale and derivatization arrows
regions.finding: Recorded the independent 7 mmol/1.29 g scale-up to 3 (79%, 1.69 g) and five distinct derivatizations 3->42, 42->43, 3->44, 3->45, and 45->46 with every displayed reagent, solvent, temperature and yield.
Mapped TEMPO trapping, H2O/D2O controls, formate-13C tracing, and Stern-Volmer quenching to the Scheme 4 records on page 4. The 52% TEMPO value remains recovery of substrate 1, not product yield.

unresolved: Scheme 2 omits row-specific absolute charges, purification, masses, and dr analytical bases.
Scheme 3 derivatizations omit absolute charges, reaction times, workups, purification, masses and yield bases.
Scheme 4 control details are completed only to the extent explicitly shown on page 4; SI was not inferred.

regions.finding: Recorded 5 equiv TEMPO under standard conditions, desired 3 not detected, 52% recovery of substrate 1, and HRMS detection of the source-depicted TEMPO adduct. Recovery and product yield remain distinct.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Scheme 4b H2O and D2O controls
regions.finding: Recorded two independent N2-atmosphere controls: H2O gives 47 in 46% isolated yield; D2O gives 48 in 52% isolated yield with 96% D. H2O/D2O amounts are not printed and remain missing.

Recorded H13COONa tracing under standard conditions with gaseous CO2, product yield 58%, and 22% 13C incorporation at the carboxyl group. The source does not state whether labeled sodium formate supplements or replaces HCOOK, so that relation is unresolved.

Recorded one comparative fluorescence-quenching series containing tBuSNa, tBuSH+Cs2CO3, tBuSH, SM, PhI and HCO2K. The qualitative thiolate-quenching conclusion is retained; graph points/slopes were not estimated.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left Scheme 4e and mechanism prose
regions.finding: Classified I-VII, photocatalyst/thiol redox states, CO2 radical anion, propargyl radical and carbanions as a proposed mechanism with ordered SET/HAT/addition/reduction/isomerization/carboxylation steps, not isolated preparations.
